A <br> just after <a> is kept as a hard line break in the label

```php title="PHP"
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

use HtmlToMarkdown\HtmlToMarkdown;
$result = HtmlToMarkdown::convert("Beta<a href=\"https://example.com\"><br>Alpha</a>");
var_dump($result->content);
```
